_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The drawer shows a pause mark when a restart interrupted a conversation. The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list and cut off its live update stream, so there is nothing to set up, intercept or check about that (do not look at the API): the drawer (".drawer") shows the conversations the test names, as rows [data-conversation-id="<id>"] whose title (".conversation-title") is their slug, which is their id (drafts have none), and whose preview is "Preview". The list is "interrupted" (its turn was interrupted) and "running" (the agent is working). Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is the element with role button (a <button>) whose accessible name (aria-label, else its text) is exactly X; "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. In the interrupted row, ".drawer-interrupted-indicator" is visible, there is no ".drawer-working-indicator", and ".conversation-time" is visible. 3. A working row's dot stands in for its age: in the running row, ".drawer-working-indicator" is visible, and there is no ".conversation-time" and no ".drawer-interrupted-indicator".
